license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, or to offer to practice, engineering in this state, as defined in the provisions of this chapter, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is an engineer, unless that person has been registered or exempted under the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of registration for professional engineers subsequently provided by this chapter.

name.value: State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers
name.quote: "Board" means the state board of registration for professional engineers subsequently provided by this chapter.

type.quote: The duty of the board of engineers is to administer those provisions of this chapter that relate to the regulation of professional engineering and the registration of professional engineers.

moral_character_required.quote: Be of good character and reputation;

degree_required.value: Graduate of an ABET-EAC accredited engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more

accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited program" means specific engineering curricula within established institutions of higher learning that have both met the criteria of, and have been designated by, the following commissions of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, Inc. ("ABET"): the Engineering Accreditation Commission ("ABET-EAC") and the Engineering Technology Accreditation Commission ("ABET-ETAC").

degree_level.quote: A graduate of an ABET-EAC accredited engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more approved by the board as being of satisfactory standing

required.quote: obtained a specific record of a minimum of four (4) years of experience in engineering work of a grade and character that indicates to the board that the applicant may be competent to practice engineering

exams.quote: may be admitted, upon application, to a NCEES examination in the principles and practice of engineering

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration shall expire on the last day of the month of June following their issuance and become invalid after that date unless renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Certificates of registration must be renewed prior to, or during the month of, June by the payment of a fee set by the board in an amount not less than one hundred fifty dollars ($150), but not to exceed one hundred eighty dollars ($180).

required.quote: Subject to the approval of the director, the board of engineers shall establish any rules and regulations for the conduct of its own proceedings; for examination of applicants; for registration of professional engineers and engineers-in-training; for continuing education requirements

available.quote: A person holding a current certificate of registration to engage in the practice of engineering, on the basis of comparable written NCEES examinations, issued to him or her by either a proper authority of a state, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or of any foreign country, and whose qualifications meet the requirements of this chapter, based on verified evidence may, upon application, be registered without further examination.

requirements.value: Must hold a current certificate of registration based on comparable written NCEES examinations from another US state/territory, DC, or foreign country, and meet RI's qualifications; OR hold a NCEES Record meeting RI's requirements.
requirements.quote: A person holding a NCEES Record, whose qualifications as evidenced by the NCEES Record meet the requirements of this chapter, may, upon application, be registered without further examination, provided he or she is qualified.

exists.quote: The duty of the board of engineers is to administer those provisions of this chapter that relate to the regulation of professional engineering and the registration of professional engineers.

national_certification.value: National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES)
national_certification.quote: "National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES)" is a nationally recognized organization that assists state boards and territorial boards to better discharge their duties and responsibilities in regulating the practice of engineering and land surveying.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, or to offer to practice, engineering in this state, as defined in the provisions of this chapter, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is an engineer, unless that person has been registered or exempted under the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: "Professional engineer" means a person who has been registered and licensed by the state board of registration for professional engineers.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, or to offer to practice, engineering in this state, as defined in the provisions of this chapter, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is an engineer, unless that person has been registered or exempted under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No individual shall: (1) Practice or offer to practice engineering in this state; (2) Use any title, sign, card, or device implying that the individual is an engineer or is competent to practice engineering in this state; ... unless that individual holds a currently valid certificate issued pursuant to this chapter or is specifically exempted from the certificate requirement under the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, or to offer to practice, engineering in this state, as defined in the provisions of this chapter ... unless that person has been registered or exempted under the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Other conduct discreditable to the engineering profession, in conjunction with other violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In conjunction with any violation of subsections (b)(1) — (b)(9), any other conduct discreditable to the engineering profession.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: every firm must obtain a certificate of authorization from the board and those individuals in direct control of the practice and who exercise direct supervision of all personnel who act in behalf of the firm in professional and technical matters must be registered with the board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation surveys, planning and design of engineering systems, and the supervision of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications; and embracing those services or work in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work, or projects in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned.
